record.title: Remove command-module coupling from shared result presentation
record.intent: Keep Click entrypoints independent while sharing established output formatting.
requirements: Move shared TOML quoting and SCPI observation rendering out of the SCPI command module into neutral presentation helpers without changing supported report bytes.
Verify reusable libraries remain independent of Click and command adapters, and delegates remain independent of command presentation.
Retain a bounded static import-layer regression control and document that it checks authored imports rather than arbitrary dynamic Python behavior.
acceptance: Shared presentation no longer requires importing another command endpoint and the documented dependency direction is checked.
